item.tib: g.yung drung phur bu'i rtse rdzogs
item.coloph: khrag 'thung rol pa'i man ngag gsang ba yang dag 'di/ stag la me 'bar gyis stag gzig rig pa gsal la gtad/ stag gzig g.yung drung rig pa gsal gyis/ stag gzig rgya gar skad tu bsgyar/ de la rgya gar nam mkha' gsal gyis zhus/ de nas mthu chen lnga la brgyud/ zhang zhung stong rgyung mthu chen gyis rgya gar skad gtsang ma'i bod skad du bsgyur/ li shu stag ring bdag 'dra yis/ phyi rabs skal ldan don du ni/ dkar chab dag la btabs nas sbas so/ skal ldan las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog
